definitions.explanation: The front wheel(s) of a vehicle — most often a car, motorcycle, or bicycle. Contrasts with {後輪|こうりん} (rear wheel).

examples.japanese: {前輪|ぜんりん}がパンクした。
この{車|くるま}は{前輪|ぜんりん}{駆動|くどう}だ。
{自転車|じてんしゃ}の{前輪|ぜんりん}がぶれているので、{自転車|じてんしゃ}{屋|や}で{調整|ちょうせい}してもらった。
examples.english: The bicycle's front wheel was wobbling, so I had a bike shop adjust it.

notes:
Compound of {前|ぜん} (front) + {輪|りん} (wheel).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前輪|ぜんりん}{駆動|くどう}: front-wheel drive (FWD)
- {前輪|ぜんりん}ブレーキ: front brake
- {前輪|ぜんりん}がパンクする: to get a flat in the front tire

RELATED WORDS:
- {後輪|こうりん}: rear wheel — the direct opposite
- {両輪|りょうりん}: both wheels (also figurative: two essential parts of something)
- {四輪|よんりん}{駆動|くどう}: four-wheel drive (4WD)
